EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Results-driven Multi-Unit Operations Leader with 8+ years of progressive restaurant management experience overseeing high-volume casual dining locations. Proven record in P&L accountability, labor optimization, team development, and regional guest satisfaction across 6-8 units generating $18M+ in annual revenue.

EXPERIENCE

Regional Operations Manager | Apex Hospitality Group (2021 – Present)
- Direct operational oversight of 7 high-volume restaurant locations with $16.5M combined annual sales and 190+ team members.
- Reduced prime labor costs by 2.8% across district through implementation of predictive staffing schedules without impacting speed-of-service metrics.
- Spearheaded district food safety and sanitation audit program, achieving 98.4% average health inspection scores across all 7 units.
- Promoted 9 internal team members to General Manager and Assistant Manager roles over 3 years, reducing district management turnover by 34%.
- Managed annual capital expenditure and operational budgets, delivering 4.2% year-over-year EBITDA expansion.

General Manager / Multi-Unit Training Lead | Sunrise Bistro Concepts (2017 – 2021)
- Managed flagship store ($3.2M volume) while serving as Lead Area Trainer for 4 adjoining franchise stores.
- Audited inventory variances weekly and renegotiated regional produce distributor terms, cutting food waste by 14%.
- Led new unit opening (NRO) task force for 3 restaurant launches, managing staffing, kitchen certification, and local store marketing.
- Maintained 92%+ guest satisfaction index score on regional mystery shopper evaluations.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS
- B.S. in Business Administration, State University (2016)
- ServSafe Manager Certified & ServSafe Alcohol Certified
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (Process Improvement)
job_description_text:
POSITION: District Manager – Multi-Unit Restaurant Operations
LOCATION: Metro Region (On-site travel to 6-10 district stores)
COMPENSATION: $95,000 - $115,000 Base Salary + 20% Performance Bonus

ABOUT THE ROLE:
We are seeking an energetic, metrics-driven District Manager to oversee operations, guest hospitality, financial performance, and leadership development across a territory of 8-10 fast-casual restaurants.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Multi-Unit Operations & P&L Oversight: Full accountability for top-line revenue, bottom-line store profitability, labor cost control, and food cost targets across 8-10 units.
2. Talent Acquisition & People Leadership: Recruit, coach, and retain top-tier General Managers; foster structured succession planning and internal promotion paths.
3. Brand Standards, Quality & Food Safety: Ensure strict compliance with corporate operational procedures, ServSafe food handling standards, and state health regulations.
4. Growth & Field Execution: Drive guest hospitality scores, resolve guest escalations, and execute seasonal marketing/promotional rollouts across all assigned stores.
5. Vendor & Capex Coordination: Collaborate with regional supply chain partners, equipment maintenance vendors, and facility contractors to ensure store operational excellence.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
- 3+ years of multi-unit restaurant management experience (managing at least 5+ locations simultaneously).
- Demonstrated track record of P&L management, EBITDA growth, and controllable cost reductions.
- Active ServSafe Manager certification.
- Proven capability to recruit, mentor, and promote restaurant leadership talent.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel daily within the assigned district.

priorities.location_preference: Metro Region / Field travel up to 50 miles
non_negotiables: Must have dedicated multi-unit territory under 12 units
Company vehicle allowance or mileage reimbursement
